about:
Complete MetalCraft LLC operates from Highland, Michigan, in the Detroit metropolitan area. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders' names in its public materials. It presents itself as a multi-process metal fabrication shop serving customers across the United States.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication, prototype and short-run metal stamping (up to 600 tons), flat and 5‑axis laser cutting (materials up to 1.5 inches thick), MIG/TIG/spot welding, and CNC machining. Equipment includes a Bridgeport VMC 4020 machining center and an Axis Mitsubishi VZ CNC laser cutter. The company emphasizes prototype assemblies, short-run production, and pre‑production parts, though it does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual part volumes.

Complete MetalCraft serves automotive Tier I and II suppliers, military and defense contractors, and alternative‑energy companies, as well as architectural and commercial clients. The firm highlights its ability to consolidate multiple processes—fabrication, stamping, laser cutting, welding, and machining—under one roof to reduce lead times and cost.

The company states that its differentiation lies in offering a single source for diverse metalworking processes, personalized service, competitive pricing, and a focus on customer satisfaction. It was started to give clients a dependable partner for prototype and short‑run metalwork that larger suppliers might overlook.
